source.implementation: independent native-width FP32 vector reference, one key-head group

hypothesis: Interleave four independent FP32 V-lane partial accumulators for memory projection and readout, then a three-add tree. Every K product is still evaluated; changed FP32 association must pass the unchanged local/full-chain bounds. Extra scratch is only3*V FP32 values, with code/descriptor growth subject to the original memory gate.
falsification: Reject any omitted K/state/normalization term, changed precision/control/timed history, canonical or replicated-prefix drift, fixed local/full-chain error failure, shutdown/core/timer mismatch, speedup below1.05x or program-memory growth above1.10x. Require all six families, fresh paired seed, both complete native profiles and worst-cell guards before a suite claim.
